author: Praxis VI
title: Test-mode: DAQB with Soft Inbound-Degree Control (no post-hoc trim)
abstract: Implements a soft inbound-degree control during neighbor selection (not post-hoc) on top of the frozen MPB-GraphFWPCA embedding. Builds a DAQB-style symmetric binary graph via a popularity-penalized kNN selection and reports diagnostics and the full 10-metric panel in task order. Test mode only; no scoring.
